title: My day
summary: A student describes a normal school day from morning to night.

sentences.en: In the morning I get up at half past six.
I have breakfast at home and drink milk.
At half past seven I take the bus to school.

sentences.zh: 上午我们上课，我很喜欢汉语课。
sentences.en: In the morning we have classes; I really like Chinese class.

sentences.zh: 中午我和同学在学校吃午饭。
sentences.en: At noon I have lunch at school with my classmates.
Classes finish at four in the afternoon, and I go home.

sentences.zh: 晚上我在家看书，写汉字。
sentences.en: In the evening I read and write characters at home.

sentences.zh: 有时候我看一点儿电视。
sentences.en: Sometimes I watch a little TV.
At ten I go to bed.

questions.prompt: When does the student get up?
why: 7:30 is when they go to school.
It's 六点半 — half past six.
Right: 中午我和同学在学校吃午饭.
Breakfast is at home, not lunch.

questions.prompt: What do they do in the evening?
why: Right: 晚上我在家看书，写汉字.
They stay at home in the evening.
